text:
sasha: Heads up 1 were seeing an mTLS degradation across multiple regions (eu-north & ap-northeast) starting ~2026-03-10T03:02Z. Clients report 'short certificate chain' and 'verify: missing intermediate'. Anyone triaging?
mike: Looking now. Ingress logs show proxies serving certs with no intermediates for a subset of nodes. Rotator logs show 'created cert object' but then 'unwrap failed: access denied'.
evan: Correlating KMS audit: several UnwrapDenied events for principal `svc/rotator-global@redwood` around 2026-03-10T03:01:58Z. The binding change in last infra sync tightened conditions on the key.
sasha: Which condition? Was this the least-privilege scoping we rolled out?
evan: Yes. The KMS binding now includes an IAM condition limiting decrypt to requests where `request.time < 2026-04-01T00:00Z` (feature flag window) and also requires `request.auth.claims.region == resource.labels.region`. Rotator runs in an aggregated control plane and doesn't send a region claim consistently. So unwraps failed intermittently.
claire: So rotator wrote issuance events before unwrap completion, proxies got placeholder bundles. Clients reject intermediate-missing chains. That explains the symptoms.
mike: Immediate mitigation: add a short-lived exception to the condition for `svc/rotator-global@redwood` and restart rotator to force unwrap & push full chains. I'll take the console path for speed.
sasha: Also need to evict cert caches on affected proxies after rotator completes. Keep the cache TTL short while we recover.
evan: Applying exception now (audit recorded). kms-audit-bot: Exception created for principal svc/rotator-global@redwood by evan at 2026-03-10T03:06Z; ttl=15m.
mike: Restarting rotator in control-plane: `kubectl -n infra rollout restart deploy/rotator --selector=global=true`
claire: Rotator logs now: `unwrap_ok` and `chain_pushed` events visible. Handshake success improving to ~88% but a tail remains.
sasha: Rolling edge proxies in eu-north & ap-northeast to clear stale bundles: `kubectl -n ingress rollout restart deploy/edge-proxy --region=eu-north,ap-northeast`
mike: Edge proxy restarts in both regions done. Handshake failures dropped to 0.5% within 7m.
evan: Root cause summary: overly strict IAM conditions on KMS key blocked rotator unwraps when the rotator identity didn't present per-region claims. Rotator emitted 'issued' prior to unwrap confirmation which led to incomplete chains being served. Long cert cache TTL on some proxies extended the visible impact.
claire: Action items: 1) Update rotator to treat 'issued' as pending until unwrap_confirmed or to emit 'issuance_pending' metric; 2) Add CI pre-apply lint to flag IAM conditions on CA keys that reference ephemeral claims (region/request.auth.*) and require a manual review; 3) Add alert: KMS UnwrapDenied spike OR rotator issuance without unwrap_confirmed -> page sec-oncall; 4) Shorten cert-cache TTL (default 5m) during rotations and backfill older proxies; 5) Surface TF change id next to KMS audit entries in console for faster correlation.
sasha: Also add a vuln-triage note: conditional IAM rules are a vector for accidental outage if identities change shape; document safe patterns.
evan: Filed SEC-62088: "IAM condition prevented KMS unwrap -> partial mTLS chains served across regions" https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SEC-62088
mike: Quick infra follow-up: let's make the console show 'rotator unwrap success' metric and annotate recent TF plans that touch CA keys.
claire: Agreed. Closing the triage thread; will reopen if alerts recur. :thumbsup:
